what: The intro text in the middle of the section sticks at 41% of the screen height, and portrait photos placed alternately on the sides (right · left) move up slightly faster than the scroll — by the distance the photo’s top edge has passed the screen bottom × .07 extra — passing behind the text. Photos follow the value late with a 1.2s ease transition, so they keep gliding briefly after scrolling stops. They move only while the section is on screen.

options.speed: Extra shift ratio per 1px of scroll, default .07
options.--fx-gap: Vertical gap between photos, default 70px (350px via --fx-gap-narrow below 576px)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Fixed text block — stands in front of the photo (z 1)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo slot that gets pushed up (required) — if left as siblings in the same parent, odd-numbered items shift to the right

note: For the text to stay stuck, the photo column must be longer than the text (section height is two or three screens). This part uses transform on the photos, so don’t apply another transform to the photo cell itself

from.where: index.html .mm-story — original Brand our-story.js (on every scroll translateY(-(scrollY − offsetTop + innerHeight) × .07), only while the section is visible via IntersectionObserver)·our-story.css (.our-story__content sticky top 41% · photo 340px · odd items margin-inline-start auto · 70px between (350px below 576) · transition transform var(--animate-time) 1.2s)
